explanation.tr:
İngilizce zamanların genel haritası:
• PRESENT: Simple (I work – alışkanlık), Progressive (I'm working – şu an), Perfect (I've worked – şimdiye bağlı geçmiş), Perfect Progressive (I've been working – süre)
• PAST: Simple (I worked – bitti), Progressive (I was working – geçmişte devam), Perfect (I had worked – daha önce), Perfect Progressive (I had been working – geçmişte bir noktaya kadar süre)
• FUTURE: will (I'll work – tahmin/karar), going to (I'm going to work – plan), Present Progressive (I'm working tomorrow – randevu), Future Progressive (I'll be working – gelecekte devam), Future Perfect (I'll have worked – gelecekte bir noktaya kadar bitmiş)
Anahtar: Simple = tamamlanmış/genel, Progressive = süreç, Perfect = önceki zamana bağlantı.
explanation.tk:
Iňlis zamanlarynyň umumy kartasy:
• PRESENT: Simple (I work – endik), Progressive (I'm working – häzir), Perfect (I've worked – häzir bilen bagly geçmiş), Perfect Progressive (I've been working – dowamlylyk)
• PAST: Simple (I worked – gutardy), Progressive (I was working – geçmişde dowam), Perfect (I had worked – has öň), Perfect Progressive (I had been working – geçmişde bir nokada çenli dowamlylyk)
• FUTURE: will (I'll work – çaklama/karar), going to (I'm going to work – meýilnama), Present Progressive (I'm working tomorrow – duşuşyk), Future Progressive (I'll be working – geljekde dowam), Future Perfect (I'll have worked – geljekde bir nokada çenli tamamlanan)
Açar: Simple = tamamlanan/umumy, Progressive = proses, Perfect = öňki wagt bilen baglanyşyk.
explanation.ru:
Общая карта времён английского языка:
• PRESENT: Simple (I work – привычка), Progressive (I'm working – сейчас), Perfect (I've worked – прошлое со связью с настоящим), Perfect Progressive (I've been working – длительность)
• PAST: Simple (I worked – закончено), Progressive (I was working – длилось в прошлом), Perfect (I had worked – ещё раньше), Perfect Progressive (I had been working – длилось до момента в прошлом)
• FUTURE: will (I'll work – прогноз/решение), going to (I'm going to work – план), Present Progressive (I'm working tomorrow – договорённость), Future Progressive (I'll be working – в процессе в будущем), Future Perfect (I'll have worked – завершится к моменту в будущем)
Ключ: Simple = факт/завершённость, Progressive = процесс, Perfect = связь с более ранним моментом.

explanation.tr:
Bu karma alıştırma B1 seviyesindeki önemli konuları tekrar eder:
• Zamanlar (Simple / Progressive / Perfect)
• Koşul cümleleri (if…)
• Passive (be + V3)
• Gerund / infinitive
• Modallar (must, should, have to)
• Karşılaştırma (-er / more / the most)
• Relative pronouns: who (insan), which (nesne), that (ikisi), where (yer), whose (iyelik)
  The man who lives next door is a doctor. The book which I bought is great.
explanation.tk:
Bu garyşyk gönükme B1 derejesindäki möhüm temalary gaýtalaýar:
• Zamanlar (Simple / Progressive / Perfect)

• Gerund / infinitive

• Deňeşdirme (-er / more / the most)
• Relative pronouns: who (adam), which (zat), that (ikisi), where (ýer), whose (eýelik)
  The man who lives next door is a doctor. The book which I bought is great.
explanation.ru:
Это смешанное упражнение повторяет важные темы уровня B1:

• Относительные местоимения: who (люди), which (предметы), that (и то, и другое), where (место), whose (чей)
  The man who lives next door is a doctor. The book which I bought is great.

explanation.tr:
Fiil biçimleri:
• Yalın hâl (V1): go, play
• Simple Past (V2): went, played
• Past participle (V3): gone, played
• -ing biçimi: going, playing
Fiil türleri:
• Yardımcı fiiller: be, have, do → zaman ve soru/olumsuz kurar
• Modallar: can, must, should, will…
• Ana fiiller: eylem (run, eat) veya durum (know, like, belong)
• Geçişli (nesne alır: She bought a car) / geçişsiz (nesne almaz: The baby slept)
• make / do: make a mistake, make a cake, make friends; do homework, do the dishes, do sport
explanation.tk:
Işlik görnüşleri:
• Esasy görnüş (V1): go, play
• Simple Past (V2): went, played
• Past participle (V3): gone, played
• -ing görnüşi: going, playing
Işlik görnüşleri:
• Kömekçi işlikler: be, have, do → zaman we sorag/ýokluk düzýär
• Modal işlikler: can, must, should, will…
• Esasy işlikler: hereket (run, eat) ýa-da ýagdaý (know, like, belong)
• Geçişli (doldurgyç alýar: She bought a car) / geçişsiz (doldurgyç almaýar: The baby slept)
• make / do: make a mistake, make a cake, make friends; do homework, do the dishes, do sport
explanation.ru:
Формы глагола:
• Начальная форма (V1): go, play
• Simple Past (V2): went, played
• Причастие прошедшего времени (V3): gone, played
• Форма на -ing: going, playing
Виды глаголов:
• Вспомогательные: be, have, do → образуют времена, вопросы и отрицания
• Модальные: can, must, should, will…
• Смысловые: действия (run, eat) или состояния (know, like, belong)
• Переходные (с дополнением: She bought a car) / непереходные (без дополнения: The baby slept)
• make / do: make a mistake, make a cake, make friends; do homework, do the dishes, do sport
